name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
label: Quest
description: Recovered correspondence from the Bloodsail Buccaneers carries a map of Booty Bay and written orders to secure a quiet camp at the marked spot and wait…

clips.title: The story
paras: Recovered correspondence from the Bloodsail Buccaneers carries a map of Booty Bay and written orders to secure a quiet camp at the marked spot and wait for a signal from their southern command post before attacking.

Following your earlier investigation into the Bloodsail Buccaneers, an intercepted map and written orders uncover the pirates' immediate plans. A red X on a map of Booty Bay marks the exact spot where the pirates are to make camp. The orders command the crew to hold their ground quietly, eliminate anyone who approaches, and await an attack signal sent from the southern command post.

Carrying these written findings back to Booty Bay brings the intelligence directly to First Mate Crazz, who originally sent you out to scout. The pirates are plainly waiting on a signal before they attack.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing.
"You men are to secure a camp at this location and keep quiet. Wait for the signal from the southern command post before attacking. If anyone approaches you, kill them."

clips.title: Completion
paras: Sure, I remember you, adventurer. Back from scouting I see....
